# Warning and Partial Status for User Journeys With Unresolved Steps

User journeys referencing steps that do not resolve to compiled entities are marked as 'partial' or 'invalid' and the missing steps are included in an 'unresolved_steps' payload field, with compile-time warnings issued.

To make incomplete or ambiguous trace chains visible and persistent, thereby surfacing gaps for further treatment and preventing silent loss of information in downstream analysis (per ADR-017 and visibility/traceability design goals).
